description: Growth, marketing, sales, and product playbooks for AI coding agents and deployed agents: one skill, 35 commands, 21 plays, a rule-based copy checker, and an MCP server.
rules: Call conquistador_brief with the task before you draft marketing or growth work, and read the playbooks it returns.
Run conquistador_check on each draft with its channel and the same context that you sent to the brief.
A host hands a draft to a person only when conquistador_verify returns valid, clean, and signed.
Install with npx @forsvn/conquistador@latest, or npm install -g @forsvn/conquistador. Use -g; without it the command is not on PATH.
Never publish, send, or spend without the user's approval each time. Never invent metrics, quotes, or customer facts.
